item.summary: docs(agents): require screenshot/video proof for UI-visible and gateway-behavior changes (#122920) Adds hard policy: UI-visible changes need before/after screenshots or a short video as PR evidence; gateway-behavior changes provable in the Control UI need an isolated dev-gateway live run with a recorded video. Documents the verified video upload flow (user-attachments endpoint, mp4/webm both served) and the bare-URL embed rule for GitHub's player.
